title: Quoted literal scalar unions accept every declared member

ground_truth.statement: Every supplied scalar is a member of the finite declared union, including a string containing a quote. The function returns each argument unchanged and the runtime checks every member.

provenance.note: Source's enum name describes scalar literal unions, not native enums. Re-derived portable @param with a quoted string and three integers, retaining parenthesized syntax.

notes: Same criterion as the invalid-int candidate. Extra redundant-comparison policy diagnostics remain observable rather than being broadly allowed.
